data.gender_notes: Imman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Imman means 'God is with us'. This name was given to several figures in the Bible, including Immanu'el, who was a prophesied savior, and the high priest Immanu-El in the Second Temple period. For Christians, Imman represents the divine presence of God in our lives and the assurance of His love and guidance. The name Imman carries the meaning “God with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Imman usually hope their child will grow to embody god with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: עימן
in_hebrew.meaning: עימן הוא שם שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו' או 'אלוהים עם נא'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עימן הוא שם עברי שמקורו מהמילה 'עמנו אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו'. זהו שם שמתייחס לנוכחותו של אלוהים בחייו של האדם. השם מופיע בתנ'ך בספר ישעיהו (ישעיהו 7:14, 8:8) ככינוי לאלוהים. השם עימן הוא גם קיצור של השם 'עמmanuel' שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו'.

in_greek.name: Ἰμμαν
in_greek.meaning: Ἰμμαν σημαίνει 'Θεός μεθ' ἡμῶν' ἤ 'Θεός παρ' ἡμῖν'
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰμμαν εἶναι ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκὸν προέλευσις ἀπὸ τὸ 'עמנו אל' ποῦ σημαίνει 'Θεός μεθ' ἡμῶν'. Εἶναι ὄνομα ἀναφορικὸν εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου. Τὸ ὄνομα Ἰμμαν ἀπεφάνη εἰς τὴν Καινή Διαθήκη εἰς τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ Ἠσαΐα (Ἠσαΐας 7:14, 8:8) ὡς ὄνομα Θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Imman
in_latin.meaning: Imman significat 'Deus nobiscum' vel 'Deus cum nobis'
in_latin.long_meaning: Imman est nomen hebraicum quod originem habet a voce 'עמנו אל' quae significat 'Deus nobiscum'. Est nomen referens ad praesentiam Dei in vita hominis. Nomen Imman apparet in Biblia in libro Isaiae (Isaia 7:14, 8:8) ut nomen Dei.

in_english.meaning: Imman means 'God is with us' or 'God with us'

The name Imman symbolizes spiritual connection, divine guidance, and reassurance of God's presence.
